"CNN Newsroom" presents the day's headlines and breaking stories live from CNN headquarters in Atlanta. The rotating cast of anchors and contributors includes Carol Costello, Kyra Phillips, Suzanne Malveaux, Brooke Baldwin, Randi Kaye and Fredricka Whitfield.

Anderson Cooper goes beyond the headlines with in-depth reporting and investigations. Through nightly "Keeping Them Honest" reports, Anderson keeps his commitment to holding those in power accountable. And, of course, there's the RidicuList, a tongue-in-cheek commentary on the day's news that may leave viewers (and Anderson) laughing. Joining him are guests that frequently include political and legal analysts.

Peabody Award-winning journalist Christiane Amanpour, CNN's chief international correspondent, hosts this half-hour weeknight interview program, with each episode focusing on a newsworthy topic and featuring guests, from global leaders to heads of state and cultural icons, who are comfortable challenging conventional wisdom.

"Backstory" es una serie que cubre en profundidad el rodaje de las películas más populares del cine. Intérpretes, directores, productores y otras figuras de Hollywood proporcionan reveladoras historias sobre los eventos que influyeron en cada producción… y en sus vidas. Usando imágenes exclusivas de películas, fotos fijas de archivo y perspicaces entrevistas, estos episodios lo revelaran todo, desde fascinantes intrigas entre bastidores hasta despiadadas políticas de estudio.
